### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. megalencephalic leukoencephalopathy with subcortical cysts 2B, remitting, with or without intellectual disability  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.784)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:26361)

**Proposed mechanism:** HEPACAM (HGNC:26361) —DISRUPTS→ Cell-cell adhesion and migration (GO:0098742); Cell-cell adhesion and migration (GO:0098742) —LEADS_TO→ Leukodystrophy (HP:0001274); Cell-cell adhesion and migration (GO:0098742) —LEADS_TO→ Subcortical cyst (HP:0030045); Cell-cell adhesion and migration (GO:0098742) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249). Loss-of-function mutations in HEPACAM disrupt normal cell-cell adhesion and migration pathways, leading to the shared phenotypes of leukodystrophy, subcortical cysts, and intellectual disability.

**How to falsify it:** The identification of distinct causal genes for each disease, or evidence that HEPACAM mutations in one disease lead to gain-of-function while in the other they lead to loss-of-function, would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: Presence of pathogenic variants in HEPACAM with a population frequency > 0.01 in gnomAD.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of HEPACAM in these distinct leukoencephalopathies could lead to therapeutic strategies targeting cell adhesion and migration pathways for broader application in related neurological disorders.
